--- pipe_aggregate_group_by_empty.sql
FROM Sales
|> AGGREGATE SUM(amount) AS total GROUP BY()

--- AST

  Query: &ast.Query{
    Query: &ast.FromQuery{
      From: &ast.From{
        Source: &ast.TableName{
          Table: &ast.Ident{
            NamePos: 5,
            NameEnd: 10,
            Name:    "Sales",
          },
        },
      },
    },
    PipeOperators: []ast.PipeOperator{
      &ast.PipeAggregate{
        Pipe:  11,
        Items: []*ast.PipeAggregateItem{
          &ast.PipeAggregateItem{
            DirPos: -1,
            Expr:   &ast.CallExpr{
              Rparen: 34,
              Func:   &ast.Path{
                Idents: []*ast.Ident{
                  &ast.Ident{
                    NamePos: 24,
                    NameEnd: 27,
                    Name:    "SUM",
                  },
                },
              },
              Args: []ast.Arg{
                &ast.ExprArg{
                  Expr: &ast.Ident{
                    NamePos: 28,
                    NameEnd: 34,
                    Name:    "amount",
                  },
                },
              },
            },
            As: &ast.AsAlias{
              As:    36,
              Alias: &ast.Ident{
                NamePos: 39,
                NameEnd: 44,
                Name:    "total",
              },
            },
          },
        },
        GroupBy: &ast.PipeAggregateGroupBy{
          Group:  45,
          And:    -1,
          Order:  -1,
          By:     51,
          Lparen: 53,
          Rparen: 54,
        },
      },
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
FROM Sales |> AGGREGATE SUM(amount) AS total GROUP BY()
